ForumCategory.label: Catégories (Forum)
ForumCategory.schema: CREATE TABLE forum_categories (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100), slug VARCHAR(100), description TEXT, parent_id INT NULL, order_index INT DEFAULT 0, icon VARCHAR(50), color VARCHAR(7), created_at DATETIME)

ForumTopic.label: Sujets (Forum)
ForumTopic.schema: CREATE TABLE forum_topics (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, category_id INT, title VARCHAR(255), slug VARCHAR(255), author_id INT, author_name VARCHAR(100), author_email VARCHAR(150), is_locked TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, is_pinned TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, views INT DEFAULT 0, last_post_at DATETIME, created_at DATETIME)

ForumPost.label: Messages (Forum)
ForumPost.schema: CREATE TABLE forum_posts (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, topic_id INT, content TEXT, author_id INT, author_name VARCHAR(100), author_email VARCHAR(150), is_approved TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME NULL, edited_at DATETIME NULL, edit_count INT DEFAULT 0)
